newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-GANZ SCORES TWICE AS INTER BEAT MONACO 3-1.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GANZ SCORES TWICE AS INTER BEAT MONACO 3-1.

text.p: Maurizio Ganz scored twice and Chile's Ivan Zamorano added a third as Internazionale took a step towards the UEFA Cup final on Tuesday with a 3-1 win over Monaco in the first leg of their semifinal.
The prolific Ganz struck on the counter-attack in the 17th and 30th minutes to take his tally in this season's competition to eight before setting up Zamorano for a killer third just before halftime.
Monaco's evening got gloomier in the 46th minute when defender Gilles Grimandi was sent off for elbowing Alessandro Pistone in an off-the-ball incident.
But Nigerian substitute Victor Ikpeba gave the French side a vital away goal and hope for the second leg when he scored with a superb individual effort in the 71st minute.
